Decent vegan dishes, lovely seating and amazing staff
May 2019 • Couples
We went here couple of times since they 1st opened. The menu is quite simple and easy to spot on what you might like to try. We had Pho Cuon ( fresh rice paper roll) and Diep Cuon ( Greenleaf roll) as starter and they also are our favourite dishes. We tried Nam Tron Thinh and it was average, not too impressive. The Chao Nam Mon ( Taro porridge with Mushroom) is delicious, perfect for a light meal. We also had Nam Chien Sot Me ( Deep fried mushroom with tamarind sauce) and my husband loved it. The Cha Gio Nam ( Mushroom springroll) is also nice for those who love fried food. Overall, we pretty much tried most of their menu in a few times here and they are quite sensible for a dine out with nice view ( when you sit on roof top) and affordable price. This become our monthly vegan eating out now. Highly recommend especially for ones doesnt like sweetfood. The taste is here is similar to Northern taste and dont forget to try their Herbal Drink! Super healthy!!!!

This review is of their 2nd outlet of Here & Now 74/1Pham Viet Chanh, Phuong 19, Quan Binh Thanh
Feb 2019 • Solo
Now it's very important to note this review is of their
brand new 2nd outlet of
Here & Now
74/1Pham Viet Chanh, Phuong 19,
Quan Binh Thanh,
HCMC.

Yes the Pad Thai is that good. Even better than I have
had in restaurants in Thailand. Even though it's one
of the signature dishes of Thailand not everyone can
get it right. It's an art to serving the noodles at the
right degree of moisture content. Often it is served
too wet and the noodles are soggy. They serve theirs 
at the perfect level of moisture so they are slightly "al dente".
On both of my visits my drink has been the Sunset
Smoothie. A mix of strawberries, Kiwi fruit, fresh milk
and some sweetened condensed milk then blended.

Their business has been so successful that they have
opened this second place which includes roof top
dining with views over the Saigon River.
The vegetarians I took there for my first visit declared
it superb. The whole restaurant has a Buddhist feel
to it. As their first restaurant in Phu Nhuan garnered
a good following among vegetarians I see this new
outlet doing even better.
So now you have a choice of two Here & Now
places to eat at.

Wonderful tasty food!
Jun 2018 • Business
I went there for lunch today with my coworkers and totally surprised to see all the tables were full. How famous it is! 
The decoration and the furniture of the restaurant are in traditional Vietnamese way which I believe will bring cozy feelings for both Vietnamese and foreign customers. It took quite long for them to prepare and serve the food which I really hope they will improve in the near future. Apart from that, the food was beyond wonderful. We got nem nấm, fried green rice, fried rice with pumpkin, noodles and pad Thai. All of them were presented beautifully and they were so delicious! I strongly recommend pad Thai and nem nấm. The variety of Vegetarian food with affordable price is also another impressive things. You will never forget this restaurant since you go there once, I bet. ;-)
